title: Copilot Completing Time Sheets by Pryme Global

chapters.title: Overview of Copilot time sheet feature
Time sheet and calendar view interface
Using Copilot to fill time sheet gaps
Review, adjust, and submit time entries

features.name: Copilot time sheet completion
features.description: A Copilot feature that completes time sheets for users by analyzing data from Microsoft Graph sources including emails, Teams calls, calendar appointments, and to-dos to suggest time sheet entries.
caveats: Users can accept or discard suggestions
Manual review and adjustment of entries is possible

features.name: Calendar view for time sheets
features.description: A calendar view feature that displays completed time sheet entries and identifies gaps that need to be filled.

features.name: Microsoft Graph integration for time sheet data
features.description: Integration with Microsoft Graph to pull data from calendar appointments, Teams calls, to-dos, and emails to generate time sheet entry suggestions.

features.name: Time sheet entry explanations
features.description: Copilot provides explanations for why each time sheet entry was suggested, allowing users to understand the reasoning behind the proposals.

quotes.text: We created a co-pilot feature for our app prime time. It completes the time sheets for users using data from the Microsoft graph
quotes.why_it_matters: Establishes that Copilot time sheet completion is already available and highlights the use of Microsoft Graph data sources.

quotes.text: it suggests time sheet entries that will complete your time sheet and the gaps that are in it
quotes.why_it_matters: Clarifies the core function of the feature: suggesting entries to fill gaps in incomplete time sheets.

quotes.text: You can use the co-pilot feature to suggest time sheet entries that will fill in those gaps
quotes.why_it_matters: Demonstrates the workflow of identifying gaps and using Copilot to resolve them.

quotes.text: The time sheet entries will be generated based on data pulled from the Microsoft graph such as calendar appointments, teams, calls, to-dos, emails, etc.
quotes.why_it_matters: Details the specific data sources used by Copilot to generate time sheet entry suggestions.

quotes.text: you can look at the entries generated and you can see some additional information with an explanation of why that was suggested
quotes.why_it_matters: Shows that Copilot provides transparency through explanations for its suggestions, enabling informed user decisions.
